name: zainab_personal_bot
cron_timezone_note: UTC expression equivalent to 9:03am Asia/Karachi, once daily
delivery: No external connector. Full content is produced as the run's own output text, viewable via the routine's run-history page.
delivery_history: Originally Gmail draft delivery; switched to Google Drive because the org's connector policy disables 'always allow' for Gmail, blocking automated/routine use. The Google Drive connector then got stuck pending approval, so delivery was switched again to routine run output only (no connector) so the bot keeps working without waiting on approvals. If Drive (or another connector) is later approved, delivery can be switched to produce a per-day shareable link.
